qs.q: A young patient presents with extreme photosensitivity, early-onset skin freckling, and multiple basal cell carcinomas after minimal sun exposure. Which specific DNA repair pathway is most likely defective?
qs.e: Xeroderma pigmentosum is caused by mutations in nucleotide excision repair genes, leading to an inability to fix UV-induced thymine dimers. Transcription-coupled repair is defective in Cockayne syndrome, which presents with premature aging rather than prominent skin cancers.
